development.label: DEVELOPMENT
development.permitted_data: Existing R2-10 DEV traces (the same 8 DEV cells frozen in experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/r2_09a/dev_corpus_manifest.json) MAY be used to implement and, if required, choose among the intentionally small retention-policy grid defined in retention_policy_space.json.
permitted_uses: unit/implementation debugging of PredictedProtectPolicy and PredictorRetentionScorePolicy
control-equivalence verification (bonus=0.0 must reproduce B_selected(M) bit-for-bit)
choosing among the 12-cell mechanism grid, IF a choice is made prior to BRIDGE holdout being opened

bridge_holdout.label: BRIDGE_HOLDOUT
bridge_holdout.definition: The 4 new, prospectively-specified BRIDGE workload instances (corpus_acquisition_contract.json.workload_instances_planned), unseen by any mechanism-selection decision until the retention mechanism/config is frozen.
bridge_holdout.freeze_before_open_rule: Once a retention mechanism/config (or small finalist subset) is selected on DEVELOPMENT data, it must be frozen (recorded in an additive provenance file) BEFORE the BRIDGE_HOLDOUT corpus is opened.
bridge_holdout.no_holdout_retuning: No mechanism, hyperparameter, or decision-gate threshold may be changed after BRIDGE_HOLDOUT is opened or after any BRIDGE result is observed.

state_machine_cross_reference: corpus_acquisition_contract.json.capture_seal_open_state_machine; BRIDGE_OPENED may only follow a committed, additive mechanism-freeze record, exactly as R2-10's EVAL_OPENED only ever followed PHASE3-EVAL-PREREGISTRATION.json's committed predictor selection.
